mapper.insert: WITH new_profile AS ( INSERT INTO profiles ( profile_id, email, username, full_name, password, phone_number, role_id, is_deleted, created_at ) VALUES ( gen_random_uuid(), #{email}, #{username}, #{fullName}, '$2a$10$bb2BXUmirgikrz7RMR1D9OV69RBckkaNZMV8dva.3WjggnOIhLudW', #{phoneNumber}, CASE WHEN #{currentUserRoleName} = 'OWNER' THEN #{roleId} ELSE (SELECT role_id FROM roles WHERE role_name = 'STAFF' AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1) END, false, NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' ) RETURNING profile_id ) INSERT INTO profile_shops ( profile_shop_id, profile_id, shop_id, role_id, created_at ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), np.profile_id, #{shopId}, CASE WHEN #{currentUserRoleName} = 'OWNER' THEN #{roleId} ELSE (SELECT role_id FROM roles WHERE role_name = 'STAFF' AND is_deleted = false LIMIT 1) END, NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh' FROM new_profile np;
